$comment: Models the Redrob Launcher can download for each Redrob app, into the folder that app reads them from. Every file is pinned to a commit or release tag and its SHA-256; URLs never point at a moving branch. app "redrob" means shared by every app. "serve" is only present for llama-server runtimes. File names are flat: a repo sub-path is flattened with a double underscore (speech_tokenizer/config.json -> speech_tokenizer__config.json), except the Kokoro voices which keep their bare names. Keep in step with each app's own catalogue (Redrob Film: crates/speech/src/models.rs and crates/tts/src/catalog.rs).
